neighbours.label: a word placing something relative to a neighbor in a sequence or ranking ('the video before it', 'those nearest the bottom')
fire: Each chapter builds on the ideas taught in the chapter before it.
Those closest to the stage heard more than those closest to the door.
Every lesson depends on the lesson before it in the course.
Those near the front see better than those near the back.
Each step repeats the work done in the step before it.
Those at the top earn more than those at the bottom.
Each level adds to the skills learned in the level before it.
Those on the left voted unlike those on the right.

Every lesson starts at nine in the morning in the hall.
Everyone at the game cheered loudly for the home team.
Each step is made of wood and painted a dark green.
Workers at the plant earn a fair wage and good benefits.
